title: Clamp a Value
description:
Write a function `clamp(value, lo, hi)` that returns `value` clamped between `lo` and `hi`:
- If `value < lo`, return `lo`
- If `value > hi`, return `hi`
- Otherwise, return `value`

**Examples:**
```python
clamp(5, 0, 10)    # 5  (within range)
clamp(-3, 0, 10)   # 0  (below min)
clamp(15, 0, 10)   # 10 (above max)
clamp(0, 0, 10)    # 0  (at boundary)
```
